title: Szabadság és felelősség: alapvető jogok (Freedom & Responsibility: Fundamental Rights)
grammar: Constitutional Regimes, Rights Guarantees & Legal Terminology in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name some rights in the Freedom and Responsibility chapter, such as dignity and equality before the law.
I can say that everyone has the right to something with mindenkinek joga van ...-hoz.
I can explain what egyenjogúság means.
I can read a short text about fundamental rights and answer questions about it.
